text:
Maya Chen: Quick ask — can someone run a small benchmark matrix for API overhead across streaming + function-calls + structured output? Need p50/p95/p99 and per-token delta vs sync for short/med/long payloads.
Samir Patel: Do you mean the new rt/stream-v2 pipeline or the legacy streaming branch?
Maya Chen: rt/stream-v2 + funcall plumbing on. Payloads: short (~20 tokens), med (~120), long (~600). Include a tool stub (returns 1 token).
Alex Rivera: I can run this. Which model/quant and do you want cold vs warm KV cache runs?
Maya Chen: Use gpt-compat-13b int8, seq_max=1024. Run cold (fresh process) and warm (same process after a few prefixes). Batch size=1, no batching.
Alex Rivera: Got it. I'll queue. Example command I used before:```bash
python tools/bench_runner.py \ --model gpt-compat-13b \ --modes streaming,funcall,structured \ --inputs samples/bench_matrix.json \ --runs 50
```
Samir Patel: For structured output use product/bench/struct_schema_v2.json as the schema, otherwise serialization differs.
infra-bot: Queued bench job 112345 — estimated 45m. (/bench run 112345)
Jordan Liao: FYI we observed ~3% token overhead previously when structured output was enabled — probably serialization + extra postprocessing.
Alex Rivera: Run 112345 started (cold + warm sets). Will post quick summary when finished.
Alex Rivera: Run 112345 complete (med payload, warm cache). Quick numbers:
- streaming: p50 92ms, p95 210ms, p99 420ms
- sync: p50 85ms, p95 190ms, p99 380ms
- token-cost delta ~+2.8%
- funcall median overhead ~+8ms
Raw artifacts: /bench/112345/results.json (includes histogram + per-token breakdown)
Maya Chen: Nice, thanks. Can you also run the long payload with structured=true and post p99? We need that for SLO decision.
Alex Rivera: queued as 112346.
infra-bot: Queued bench job 112346 — estimated 30m. (/bench run 112346)
Alex Rivera: 112346 done: long payload (warm) p99 streaming 1.90s, sync 1.65s. Structured output adds ~140ms; funcall adds ~60-80ms depending on tool latency.
Maya Chen: Thanks — that's higher than I hoped. I'll add these numbers to the perf doc and start a short note for product impact. @Jordan Liao can you triage serialization hotspot?
Jordan Liao: On it. I'll pull profiler traces from /bench/112346/profiles and run a flamegraph. If there's a quick win (e.g., avoid reserializing intermediary structs) I'll open a PR.
Maya Chen: Awesome. Also cc @Samir Patel for any infra-level batching/cache suggestions. :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: Will review traces and check whether kernel-selection or tokencache alignment is amplifying the overhead.
Alex Rivera: Added a short log summary to the perf doc: https://redwood.internal/perf/bench-matrix-112345-112346 (internal).
Maya Chen: Great coordination — thanks everyone. I'll follow up in the perf doc with recommended short-term mitigations.
Jordan Liao: If anyone needs the raw traces DM me, otherwise I'll post findings here in a day.
Maya Chen: Perfect — closing the loop here.
